title: Mølmer-Sørensen gates in trapped-ions chains in the presence of correlated noise
summary: We analyze the impact of correlated laser frequency noise on Mølmer-Sørensen gates in qubit registers based on trapped-ion chains. Using perturbation theory, we calculate gate fidelities in the presence of noise with arbitrary power spectral density for different chain lengths and ion positions in the chain. With our approach, we account for simultaneous excitation of multiple phonon modes during gate operation.
